## [1.37.2](https://github.com/quantavil/edge-morphe-patches/compare/v1.37.1...v1.37.2) (2026-11-14)


### Bug Fixes

* preserve Edge account state helpers in Copilot patch ([7a61342](https://github.com/quantavil/edge-morphe-patches/commit/7a61342e29a7323412caf1d4f4cbe7b0b943b314))

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the application package name in AndroidManifest.xml (e.g. for media display whitelist compatibility or cloning).

options.description: New package name for Microsoft Edge (defaults to <originalPackage>.morphe if not specified)

patches.name: Copilot feature toggle
patches.description: Disables all Copilot and Bing Chat feature flags by forcing boolean feature evaluation methods to return false.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch does not work if the app is installed by mounting and may cause unexpected issues with some apps.

patches.name: Disable news notifications
patches.description: Disables Bing news and weather push notifications by short-circuiting device push token registration and notification dispatch services.

patches.name: Telemetry elimination
patches.description: Eliminates Microsoft Edge telemetry and tracking by redirecting data collection endpoints (OneCollector, AppCenter, Adjust) to localhost and short-circuiting OneDS and Adjust tracking methods.
